Chapter 668: Chapter 9: Lin Yuan'S Strange Adventure (5000 Words, Please Subscribe)

Chapter 668: Chapter 9: Lin Yuan’s Strange Adventure (5000 words, please subscribe)

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm opens once every two hundred thousand years.

Each opening lasts for a hundred years.

Lin Yuan did not enter at the beginning of the opening of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Instead, to avoid the time when other powerful beings would enter the realm, he deliberately waited thirty to forty years before sending the Taiyang Divine Spirit there.

At that time, Lin Yuan had just entered the Ninth Rank, and although he had stabilized his rank with the help of dozens of cosmic forces,

he still had a significant gap compared to other Ninth Stage Peak beings in the universe.

...

In addition, Lin Yuan entered the Xuanhuang Secret Realm not for treasures or opportunities but to figure out the source of a mysterious calling.

That’s why he specifically avoided the “peak” time to enter the realm.

“This Xuanhuang Secret Realm has also witnessed my growth at the Ninth Rank stage,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

When the Xuanhuang Secret Realm first opened, Lin Yuan was merely at the Ninth Rank Myriad Layer Realm, nowhere profound enough within that realm.

But now, as the Xuanhuang Secret Realm is about to close, Lin Yuan has redefined the value of the Ninth Rank in front of the Ten Thousand Universe Races.

Could a Ninth Rank lifeform really be this powerful?

Could a regular Ninth Rank life manage to forcefully subdue those unique species within the same rank?

…

“Over these twenty years, my understanding of the Rule of Time… has almost reached a complete understanding,” Lin Yuan shifted his focus away from the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

After being led by Xia Qin Supreme Being to temporarily escape the River of Time and come ashore,

Lin Yuan’s understanding of the Rule of Time had advanced by leaps and bounds over the past twenty years.

Specifically, Lin Yuan had built upon the existing two thousand one hundred seventy-three time rule models known to mankind

and constructed one thousand nine hundred fifty-three new time rule models.

Compared to the nearly ten thousand Space Rules models, one only needs to comprehend them all to fully understand the Space Rules.

The time rule models summarized by human civilization, even if fully understood, are still a long distance away from fully comprehending the Rule of Time.

At least from the current vast number of universal lifeforms, the complexity of understanding the Rule of Time far surpasses that of Space Rules.

Of course, the threshold for Space Rules is low, but its ultimate potential is nearly as profound as that of the Rule of Time.

Even among Supreme Beings, there are those like one of the nine Supreme Beings of human civilization, the Void God Ultimate Being,

and the Moyu Tower Master who are exceedingly proficient in Space Rules.

In fact, for Supreme Beings, Space Rules are no longer just rules, but a Great Dao.

The Space Great Dao.

…

“The one thousand nine hundred fifty-three new time rule models I constructed are solely applicable to my understanding of the Rule of Time and cannot be as widespread as the previous two thousand one hundred seventy-three models,” Lin Yuan pondered internally.

The time domain evolutionary scholars of human civilization, almost all at the Tier 11 level, have basically fully understood the Rule of Time.

Could they only have constructed two thousand one hundred seventy-three time rule models?

Certainly not.

However, those two thousand one hundred seventy-three time rule models enable the vast majority of Evolvers to comprehend them in the easiest way.

As for more profound time rule models, they certainly exist, but first, they are very challenging to comprehend,

and second, they are not necessarily applicable to every Evolver, which is why they are not entirely public.

Just like the one thousand nine hundred fifty-three time rule models newly constructed by Lin Yuan, which encapsulate his most fundamental understanding of the Rule of Time,

comprehension by other Evolvers is nearly akin to deciphering mystical texts; they might as well honestly experience time fluctuations more reliably.

“I have a premonition that when I construct the two thousand fiftieth new time rule model, it will be the moment I fully comprehend the Rule of Time.”

This means that Lin Yuan needs to construct fewer than a hundred new time rule models to fully understand the Rule of Time.

The time required would range from as little as three to four years to as long as seven to eight years.

This is not much different from his initial plan to understand the Rule of Time within thirty years.

…

Boom, boom, boom.

Inside the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

A mystic black luster pierced the heavens and the earth,

covering both the core and inner areas of the realm.

All extraneous life forms within this region would be eradicated by the power of the realm.

In a nondescript valley within the inner area,

a special Ninth Rank with a concealed aura, who had opened nearly thirty million Spatial Layers, stood there.

At this moment, the mystic black luster from the deepest part of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, reaching through heaven and earth, was about to envelop the valley where he stood.

“With my strength, as long as I break through the human civilization’s blockade line just before the realm closes and enter the outer area, I have at least a 30% chance of successfully leaving the realm,” the special Ninth Rank thought silently.

The Ninth Rank Evolvers of human civilization, maintaining the blockade line from the inner to the outer area, are already exceedingly strained.

Furthermore, since he was a special Ninth Rank, he had the confidence to sweep through most other Ninth Ranks.

If not for the fear of the possible appearance of the Galaxy Master, this special Ninth Rank felt his chances of leaving the Xuanhuang Secret Realm would exceed 90%.

But even so, a 30% chance was not low.

It was certainly better than waiting for death in the inner area.

But the Peak Clans’ grand alliance, such as the Insect Race and Tianyu Clan, didn’t allow him to do so.

Having a 30% chance to leave the Xuanhuang Secret Realm equated to a 70% chance of dying by human hands.

Were he to die, the numerous treasures and weapons he carried would fall into human hands.

And considering that he, as a special Ninth Rank, only had a 30% chance of escaping, those ordinary Ninth Rank Different Species probably had even less than a 10% chance.
